userStories.title: Verify Discogs platform query for ALCD-1197
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to verify Discogs can query ALCD-1197 via API or web scraping to ensure core query logic works.
acceptanceCriteria: Call queryDiscogs('ALCD-1197') returns status: 'found'

userStories.notes: ALCD-1197 returns 'not_found' correctly (doesn't exist in Discogs). Verified with TOCP-6701 that query returns 'found' with all 4 fields. Fixed: catno= param instead of q=, exact catalog match, updated web selectors for modern Discogs site.
